patch_list: Bypass maintenance and force update
Disables maintenance lock and force-update screens by overriding the status endpoint.
Change API endpoint
Points the app to a custom backend server by modifying environment variables.
Custom Google Maps API key
Replaces the Google Maps API key in the manifest with a custom one.
Custom map style
Replaces Google Maps styling with Dark Mode, AMOLED, or Retro theme.
Custom microservices endpoints
Points individual microservices to custom server URLs.
Custom Umami endpoint
Points the app to a custom Umami analytics server.
Disable background location service
Disables persistent background location service and wake locks to save battery.
Enable network interception
Enables cleartext HTTP traffic and user-installed certificate trust for debugging.
Force environment
Replaces the production environment variables with the developer or local ones.
Remove Firebase tracking
Removes Firebase App ID and Crashlytics API keys to disable Google tracking.
Remove Google Maps API key
Removes the Google Maps API key from the manifest to stop Google tracking.
Remove Umami tracking
Disables Umami tracking safely by modifying existing environment values.
